web_install_sub: Open ShikkhokPlus in its own window, from your desktop or home screen
web_offline_ready: ShikkhokPlus now opens without a connection.
web_offline_banner: You're offline. What's on screen is what was last loaded; nothing changes until you're back online.
web_offline_shell: This screen needs a connection. Nothing is stored on this computer, so there's nothing to show until you're back online.
web_not_on_web_body: This part of ShikkhokPlus is in the Android app for now. It is coming to the web next.
web_more_payments_on_android: Splitting a payment across children, or crediting an overpayment, is in the Android app for now.
web_shared_computer: On a shared computer, log out when you're done.
